# Dr Buttons Integrative Health

> Dr Buttons Integrative Health is an Australian telehealth clinic. It connects people with an AHPRA-registered doctor for an online consultation about ongoing pain, sleep and stress, or about quitting smoking or vaping. Tagline: Where Science Meets Wellness.

## What we treat
- [Pain, sleep and stress](https://drbuttons.com.au/treatments/natural-alternative-medicine/): An online consultation with a registered Australian doctor.
- [Quit smoking and vaping](https://drbuttons.com.au/treatments/quit-smoking-vaping/): Talk to a doctor about a plan to stop.

## Key facts
- Phone consultations available Australia-wide.
- Every consultation is with an AHPRA-registered doctor.
- A few short questions help book the right appointment and brief the doctor. They are not a diagnosis and do not decide treatment. A registered doctor decides everything in a real-time consultation.
- The consultation fee is $0. Any treatment, if clinically appropriate, is discussed with the patient and charged separately.
- Health information is stored securely, hosted in Australia, and handled under the Australian Privacy Principles.
